title: Game Developer Roadmap
summary: A four-year game-development path focused on programming, mathematics, game engines, 2D/3D graphics, physics, game AI, multiplayer systems, optimization and interactive design.

facts.Timeline assumption: Four-year B.Tech/B.E. beginning in 2026 and graduating around 2030.

about.label: Career-route check
about.text: Game Developer is directly aligned with CSE - Game Development / AR-VR. The strongest preparation combines software engineering fundamentals with a game engine, graphics and a portfolio of playable projects.

horizons.question: What can I enter now?
horizons.output: game-development internships, gameplay programming, technical-art or AR/VR projects

horizons.question: How should I specialise?
horizons.output: gameplay systems, graphics, tools, mobile, multiplayer or XR

horizons.question: How should I evolve?
horizons.output: senior engineering, game systems architecture, rendering or technical leadership

horizons.question: How can I remain relevant?
horizons.output: real-time 3D, AI-assisted development, XR, cloud gaming and advanced rendering

blocks.text: 4-year honours variant

Use an additional honours year for advanced rendering, game engine architecture, procedural generation, multiplayer infrastructure, computer graphics research or a substantial commercial-style game project.
Specialisation options

rows.text: C++, navigation, behaviour systems, ML basics

blocks.label: Evolve and stay relevant, 2035–2046
blocks.text: Move from implementing individual gameplay features toward complex systems, rendering, engine technology, multiplayer infrastructure or technical leadership. Keep current with real-time 3D, AI-assisted development, procedural generation and XR.

Career progression
These are indicative career stages, not guaranteed promotion timelines.
PhD routes

Senior game-development work can expand into real-time rendering, simulation, XR, procedural generation, AI-driven game systems, cloud-connected experiences and engine technology. Maintain strong C++/systems knowledge while developing expertise in graphics APIs, performance optimisation and emerging interactive-computing platforms.
